health.notChecked.message: {domain} hasn't been checked against blocklists yet; the first check runs within the hour
health.notChecked.note: a reason under the sender health score, followed by a link (action.*); domain: news.acme.io

health.clean.message: {count, plural, one {{assets} is clean on {sources} of {sources} blocklists} other {{assets} are clean on {sources} of {sources} blocklists}}
health.clean.note: assets: domains and IPs, a list like news.acme.io and 203.0.113.25; count: how many; sources: how many blocklists were checked

health.domainListed.note: asset: a domain; names: the blocklists, like UCEPROTECT L3

health.stale.message: Blocklist results for {asset} are from {day} {time}: HostRepute can't be refreshed
health.stale.note: day and time: when the results were fetched, like Mon 2 Jan 15:04

health.authNotChecked: SPF, DKIM and DMARC for {domain} haven't been checked yet

health.authFails.message: {failing} fails on {domain}; receivers may reject or spam-folder the mail
health.authFails.note: failing: SPF, DKIM or both (SPF and DKIM)

health.noDmarc: {domain} has no valid DMARC record, so receivers can't verify the domain

health.unaligned.message: {providers} mail isn't aligned with {domain} in DMARC reports
health.unaligned.note: providers: sending providers, a list like SendGrid and Mailgun

health.policyNone: SPF and DKIM are aligned on every sending provider, but DMARC is p=none, so receivers don't act on failures

health.aligned.message: SPF, DKIM and DMARC (p={policy}) aligned on every sending provider
health.aligned.note: policy: the DMARC policy, quarantine or reject, never translated

health.nothingSent: Nothing was sent in the last 7 days, so there are no bounce or complaint rates to check

health.rateOver.message: {kind, select, bounces {{provider} bounces are {value}, over its {limit} limit} other {{provider} complaints are {value}, over its {limit} limit}}
health.rateOver.note: kind: bounces or complaints; value and limit: rates, like 0.12% and 0.1%

health.rateClose.message: {kind, select, bounces {{provider} bounces are {value}, close to its {limit} limit} other {{provider} complaints are {value}, close to its {limit} limit}}
health.rateClose.note: kind: bounces or complaints; value and limit: rates

health.rateHalf.message: {kind, select, bounces {Bounces {bounce} and complaints {complaint} across providers; {provider} bounces are past half of its {limit} limit} other {Bounces {bounce} and complaints {complaint} across providers; {provider} complaints are past half of its {limit} limit}}
health.rateHalf.note: bounce and complaint: the rates across providers; kind: which of the provider's rates is past half its limit

health.ratesOk: Bounces {bounce} and complaints {complaint} across providers, well inside every limit
health.ipListed: Dedicated IP {asset} is listed on {listed} of {sources} sources ({names})

health.providerIpListed.message: {provider} IP {asset} is listed on {listed} of {sources} sources ({names})
health.providerIpListed.note: provider: a sending provider's short name, like Postal

health.warmup.note: provider: a sending provider's short name

health.warmupShare.message: {provider} warm-up is on day {day} of {days}, so {share} of broadcasts ride a young IP

health.downSince.note: time: a time of day, like 14:05

health.downAuth: {provider} rejects ReputeCast's credentials, so nothing goes through it

health.webhooksSilent.message: {provider} webhooks have been silent since {time}, so its bounces and complaints aren't counted

health.sandbox: {provider} is in sandbox mode and only sends to verified addresses

action.openDeliverability.note: a link after a sender health reason: … · open Deliverability

action.seeStreams: see what each stream is doing

provider.selfHosted.note: name: a sending provider's name, like Postal

provider.streamShare.note: percent: a percentage, like 10%; a provider's share of a stream: 10% of Broadcasts; stream: one of the stream.* names

provider.statusPage.note: name: AWS, Postmark, Mailgun, SendGrid or Resend

tier.active.note: what the Active engagement tier means

tier.range.note: what the Cooling and At risk tiers mean

policy.off: No sunset policy: Sunset contacts keep receiving broadcasts.

policy.on.message: {mode, select, both {Sunset contacts get one re-engagement email, then stop receiving broadcasts after {days} days} stop {Sunset contacts stop receiving broadcasts after {days} days} reengage {Sunset contacts get one re-engagement email and keep receiving broadcasts} other {Sunset contacts keep receiving broadcasts}}{erase, select, yes {; they're erased after {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} in Sunset} other {}}.
policy.on.note: the sunset policy in one sentence; mode: what happens to Sunset contacts; erase: whether they're erased after some months
